title: Florida Amendment 3 Homestead Savings by County
subtitle: Estimated 2027 and 2028 non-school tax savings, all 67 Florida counties
description:
What Florida's Amendment 3 (November 3, 2026 ballot) would save homestead owners in each of the state's 67 counties, computed from every homestead parcel on the Florida Department of Revenue's 2026 preliminary roll (5,251,737 homesteads) and each county's 2025 non-school millage. The amendment raises the non-school homestead exemption to $150,000 in 2027 and $250,000 in 2028. School taxes do not change.

Estimates hold assessed values at 2026 and ignore senior, veteran and other exemptions.

Canonical page, calculator and citation: https://stepuplaw.com/florida-amendment-3/
Source repository and model: https://github.com/stepuplaw/florida-amendment-3-homestead-database
DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23226000
Author: Kevin D. Klagge, Klagge Law, PLLC, ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0002-1385-8498

Estimates, not tax advice.
